OkHttp includes data derived from the Public Suffix List.
Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0.txt)
The source list and its license are available at:
https://github.com/publicsuffix/list
https://publicsuffix.org/list/public_suffix_list.dat

These upstream components are unmodified. Qiban's native-only cookie policy is application code.
This directory is included as Android APK assets; JVM test dependencies are not packaged.
